   assert hashes=={p:r["sha256"] for p,r in record["outputs"].items()}

   if rel==f"platforms/{target}/resources/activation.md":

    base=root/folder/"skills/init/references"/target/"activation.md"
  body=re.sub(chr(96)*3+r"[\s\S]*?"+chr(96)*3,"",text)
  for m in common.LINK.finditer(body):
   dest=m[1].strip().strip("<>")
   if re.match(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:",dest):continue
   filename,_,anchor=dest.partition("#")

    parent=parent/part
